info.name: Sync automation from latest Git release

params.name: id
params.description: Automation target to sync, such as agents.invoice-agent or workflows.extract. Do not include a version; sync always uses the latest Git release.

items.docs: Reconciles automation registry metadata and trigger projections from the latest Git source release. This operation is idempotent for unchanged source state: repeated calls against the same latest release leave the same automation registry state and may repeat the same warnings. Requires a Bearer API token for the organization and a user-backed API key. It does not publish source; it reads the already-published latest release manifest. Versioned targets are rejected with 400, missing organization
